summary: Wedemark (17 districts, administrative seat Mellendorf) has two free-to-enter park-and-ride sites at S-Bahn stations that Deutsche Bahn lists as open 24 hours: Bennemühlen with 182 spaces and Bissendorf with 67 spaces; neither DB page states a fee. Hannover.de says all park-and-ride sites in the GVH area are free and open round the clock, but this is a general statement that does not name the Wedemark sites. No official source on paid on-street parking or a parking statute was found. Recent developments are mainly around rail access: on 15 September 2026 the Region Hannover and the mayor opened covered bike-and-ride facilities with 158 bicycle spaces at Bissendorf and Bennemühlen (about 550,000 euros); a municipal notice of April 2026 announced floor-sensor replacement at the Bennemühlen P+R on 27 and 28 April 2026; and a January 2026 notice reports that the S4 line had suffered a complete outage before an external rail company was hired, with hourly and then half-hourly service announced. The Region Hannover's SUMP process includes an expert workshop announced for 28 October 2026 in Bissendorf (invited stakeholders, registration closed 21 October). The on-demand sprinti bus recorded over 236,000 trips in Wedemark since May 2024 by June 2025, the highest per-capita use in the Region. Enercity planned 14 public charging points at seven sites, with the first opened in June 2023. A stadtmobil car at the Mellendorf town hall was announced as bookable all day in summer 2025, and a parklet opened in Mellendorf in April 2023. The 2017 traffic concept decision is documented, but no outcome was found.

items.text: The Deutsche Bahn station page for Bennemühlen (read 21 October 2026) lists the open P+R Bennemühlen at Am Bahnhof, 30900 Wedemark, with 182 spaces in total and opening hours of 00:00-24:00 every day including public holidays. It does not state a fee.

A municipal notice of 17 April 2026 announced that on 27 and 28 April 2026 specialist firms would replace floor sensors on part of the Bennemühlen P+R facility. Several bays were to be blocked for those two days and commuters were advised to use other parking. The notice says all spaces would be fully available again after the work. The page does not confirm that the work was completed.
items.source_title: Technik wird erneuert: Einschränkungen am Bahnhof Bennemühlen (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: On 15 September 2026 the Region Hannover and the mayor opened new covered, partly lockable bike-and-ride facilities at Bissendorf and Bennemühlen stations with 158 bicycle spaces in total. The two facilities cost about 550,000 euros (Land Niedersachsen about 40 percent, Region Hannover 60 percent), and free spaces can be booked via the Region's app 'Umsteigen: Aufsteigen'.
items.source_title: Neue Bike-and-Ride-Anlagen machen den Weg zur S-Bahn komfortabler und sicherer (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: The Region Hannover is preparing a Sustainable Urban Mobility Plan (SUMP) that bundles existing goals such as the VEP 2035+ 'Aktionsprogramm Verkehrswende'. A second expert workshop with first interim results and scenario calculations was announced for 28 October 2026 in the Bürgerhaus Bissendorf (Wedemark).
items.source_title: Mobilität der Zukunft auf den Prüfstand: SUMP-Fachworkshop (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: A municipal notice of 13 January 2026 reports that after a complete outage of the S4 S-Bahn line, operator Transdev had bought in services from an external rail company. The line was to run hourly again from the following Thursday, and a half-hourly service was announced from 19 January. The page does not say when the outage began. The mayor called for serious discussion about how S-Bahn operation is organised in future, including examining a separate S-Bahn division within üstra.
items.source_title: Druck aus Region bringt S4 zurück auf die Schiene (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: In June 2023 the first of 14 public EV charging points were opened at the town hall in Mellendorf; enercity builds and operates them at seven sites (Bissendorf, Brelingen, Elze, Mellendorf x3, Resse). The other points were to follow in summer 2023.
items.source_title: Erste öffentliche Ladesäule für E-Autos eingeweiht (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: The municipal project 'Mobilität Energie Wedemark' (MoEWe), running since September 2020, covers expansion of public charging infrastructure, alternative mobility forms and an energy balance for the municipality (page undated, read 21 October 2026).

The municipality's transport page (read 21 October 2026) says S-Bahn services run from Bennemühlen, Mellendorf and Bissendorf to Hannover every 30 minutes, and the on-demand 'sprinti' buses (GVH) have supplemented local transport since June 2021 with a near 15-minute service to all districts.

Hannover.de (page undated, read 21 October 2026) states that all park-and-ride facilities in the GVH area are free to use and open around the clock, with roughly 6,100 car spaces in total. The ÜSTRA page (read 21 October 2026) likewise says its roughly 6,000 P+R spaces can be used free of charge.
items.source_title: Parken (Hannover.de, Region Hannover) and Park & Ride / Bike & Ride (ÜSTRA)

items.text: The Deutsche Bahn station page for Bissendorf (read 21 October 2026) lists the open P+R Bissendorf Bahnhof at Im Tannengrund, Wedemark, with 67 spaces in total, open 00:00-24:00 daily including holidays.

By June 2025 the on-demand bus sprinti had logged more than 236,000 trips in Wedemark since May 2024, the highest per-capita use of any municipality in the Region Hannover. On average 4,400 people board per day, many in Mellendorf, Bissendorf and Elze, and the service is included in the normal transit fare.
items.source_title: Wedemärkerinnen und Wedemärker fahren am häufigsten sprinti (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: A municipal notice of 25 June 2025 announced that from 1 July to 31 August 2025 residents could book the stadtmobil car-sharing vehicle at the Mellendorf town hall all day, including normal office hours. The car is normally reserved in the daytime for municipal staff. The notice dates from 2025 and does not confirm the vehicle's current availability.
items.source_title: Sommerferien: CarSharing-Fahrzeug in Mellendorf ganztägig buchbar (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: A municipal notice of 13 December 2024 announced that the Region Hannover was running an online participation for its new Nahverkehrsplan (local transport plan) until 15 January 2025, with a survey and an interactive map on which users could propose new lines, stations or stops. The plan concerns the whole Region, not only Wedemark.

A municipal notice of 19 April 2023 reports the inauguration of the first parklet in Wedemark, at Hellendorfer Kirchweg / Berliner Straße in Mellendorf. The Region Hannover built it for 12,000 euros and makes it available free of charge; the municipality maintains it. The notice describes parklets in general as street furniture built in place of parked cars, but does not say how many parking spaces this one replaced.
items.source_title: Erstes Parklet in der Wedemark eingeweiht (Gemeinde Wedemark)

items.text: On Monday 3 April 2017 the municipality's Verwaltungsausschuss unanimously decided to award a contract for a comprehensive traffic concept (Verkehrskonzept) for Wedemark. A planning firm was to carry out traffic studies and show first solution options, with the first results to be presented publicly before the 2017 summer holidays. The notice (published 6 April 2017) does not mention parking measures, and the outcome is not documented there.

gaps: No official source found on paid on-street parking, parking-disc zones, residents' parking or parking fees in Wedemark's centres (Mellendorf, Bissendorf, Resse); only an unofficial traveller comment mentioned a 3-hour disc limit in Mellendorf, which was not used.

No Stellplatzsatzung or council/committee decision on parking found: the council information system https://www.wedemark.sitzung-online.de/public/vo040 has a full-text search that did not respond to queries in the browser, and the Ortsrecht folder pages (https://www.wedemark.de/gemeinde/rathaus-und-verwaltung/ortsrecht/) did not expand to document lists.
The 2017 Verkehrskonzept results and any later traffic concept outcomes, including any parking recommendations, were not found.

No statement on utilisation or plans to expand the Bennemühlen or Bissendorf P+R found; no Region Hannover or GVH page specific to Bennemühlen opened (https://www.gvh.de/service/rad-auto-carsharing/park-ride-bike-ride/ redirected to the ÜSTRA page, which has only a general list).
No Mellendorf station parking page on bahnhof.de (https://www.bahnhof.de/mellendorf/parkplaetze returned 'not found'); station-area redevelopment plans not found.
Fee/time-limit details of the P+R sites: only parking-listing portals mention a 2-hour limit, which conflicts with Hannover.de's 'free, open round the clock'; those portals were not used.
Regional press (HAZ, Wedemark-related) was not opened; WebSearch returned no usable local press on parking.
EV charging: only the 2023 enercity rollout (14 points) was sourced; current number of points and any charging at the P+R sites were not found.
